questions.prompt:
Complete the matrix. Across each row, the filled shape moves from the left of the open shape to its right.
Row 1: ● ○ | ○ ●
Row 2: ■ □ | ?
questions.explanation: The filled square moves from left of the open square to its right.

questions.prompt:
Complete the matrix. Down each column, one vertical line is added.
Top-left: |
Bottom-left: ||
Top-right: ||
Bottom-right: ?
questions.explanation: The lower cell has one additional vertical line, so two lines become three.

questions.prompt:
Complete the matrix. In each row, the third cell contains the first symbol followed by the second symbol twice.
Row 1: ○ | □ | ○ □ □
Row 2: △ | + | ?
questions.explanation: The rule produces △ followed by two plus signs: △ + +.

questions.prompt:
Complete the matrix. Across each row, the arrow reverses direction and the symbol after it changes from + to ×.
Row 1: ↑ + | ↓ ×
Row 2: → + | ?
questions.explanation: The arrow opposite → is ←, and + changes to ×.
The shared symbols in the two Row 2 groups are + and ×.

questions.prompt: A square paper is folded from right to left. A hole is punched near the folded paper’s bottom edge, halfway between its left and right sides and away from the fold. What appears after unfolding?

choices.A: Two holes in a horizontal pair near the bottom
choices.B: Four holes near the bottom corners
choices.C: Two holes in a vertical pair
choices.D: One hole on the bottom edge

questions.correctAnswer: Two holes in a horizontal pair near the bottom
questions.explanation: The vertical unfold reflects the punch horizontally, creating two holes near the bottom.

questions.prompt: A rectangle is folded from bottom to top. Two holes are punched at different horizontal positions, both away from edges. What appears after unfolding?

choices.B: Four holes forming two vertical pairs

questions.correctAnswer: Four holes forming two vertical pairs
questions.explanation: Each punch reflects across the horizontal fold, giving two vertical pairs and four holes.

questions.prompt: A square is folded left to right and then top to bottom. A circular cut is made at the corner of the folded square formed by the two original outer edges. What appears after unfolding?

choices.A: One circular opening at the center
choices.C: Four openings meeting at the center
choices.D: Four quarter-circle cuts, one at each outer corner

questions.correctAnswer: Four quarter-circle cuts, one at each outer corner
questions.explanation: That folded corner stacks the four original outer corners, so unfolding places a quarter-circle cut at each corner.

questions.prompt: A square is folded once along the diagonal from upper-right to lower-left. A hole is punched exactly on the folded diagonal, away from corners. What appears after unfolding?

choices.B: Two holes mirrored across the diagonal

questions.correctAnswer: One hole on the diagonal
questions.explanation: A punch on the fold line maps onto itself, so only one hole appears.

questions.prompt:
The following groups share one rule:
1. ○ ● ●
2. □ ■ ■
3. △ ▲ ▲
Which choice follows the same rule?
questions.explanation: Each group has one open shape followed by two filled versions of the same shape.

questions.prompt:
The following arrangements share one rule:
1. Top ○; middle +; bottom □
2. Top △; middle +; bottom ◇
3. Top ☆; middle +; bottom ○
Which choice follows the same rule?
questions.correctAnswer: Top □; middle +; bottom △
questions.explanation: Two different open shapes appear above and below a central plus sign.

questions.prompt:
The following pairs share one rule:
1. | becomes -
2. / becomes \
3. - becomes |
Which choice follows the same rule?
questions.correctAnswer: \ becomes /
questions.explanation: Each line is rotated 90°; a backslash becomes a forward slash.

questions.prompt:
Complete the matrix. Across each row, the last symbol moves to the front.
Row 1: ○ □ △ | △ ○ □
Row 2: + × ★ | ?
questions.explanation: Moving the last symbol ★ to the front gives ★ + ×.

questions.prompt:
Complete the matrix. In each row, two open shapes become one filled shape of the same kind.
Row 1: ○ ○ | ●
Row 2: □ □ | ?
questions.explanation: Two open squares combine into one filled square.

questions.prompt:
Complete the matrix. Down each column, the symbol inside and the symbol outside exchange positions.
Top-left: + inside ○
Bottom-left: ○ inside +
Top-right: × inside □
Bottom-right: ?
questions.correctAnswer: □ inside ×
questions.explanation: Exchanging positions puts □ inside ×.

questions.prompt:
Complete the matrix. From left to right, the arrow turns 90° counterclockwise and one + is added.
Cell 1: → +
Cell 2: ↑ + +
Cell 3: ?
questions.explanation: Turning ↑ another 90° counterclockwise gives ←, and a third plus is added.

questions.prompt: A square is folded from top to bottom. A hole is punched near the folded paper’s right edge and a second hole near its left edge, at different distances from the fold. What appears after unfolding?

choices.A: Eight holes at equal distances from the center
choices.B: Two holes near the bottom edge
choices.C: Four holes in one horizontal line
choices.D: Four holes forming two vertical mirrored pairs

questions.correctAnswer: Four holes forming two vertical mirrored pairs
questions.explanation: Each of the two punches reflects vertically, producing two mirrored pairs and four holes.

questions.prompt: A rectangle is folded from left to right. A semicircular cut is made on the vertical folded edge, away from top and bottom. What appears after unfolding?

choices.A: One complete circular opening centered on the vertical centerline
choices.B: Two semicircles on the outer edges
choices.D: One semicircle on the right edge

questions.correctAnswer: One complete circular opening centered on the vertical centerline
questions.explanation: The semicircle on the fold reflects to complete one circle centered on the fold line.

questions.prompt: A square is folded top to bottom and then left to right. A hole is punched near the center of the folded square, away from edges. What appears after unfolding?

choices.D: Four holes, one in each quadrant

questions.correctAnswer: Four holes, one in each quadrant
questions.explanation: Two perpendicular folds reflect the punch into four corresponding quadrant positions.

questions.prompt: A square is folded along the diagonal from lower-left to upper-right. A notch is cut from the folded paper’s lower outer edge, away from corners and the fold. What appears after unfolding?

choices.B: Two notches on adjacent outer edges, mirrored across the diagonal
choices.D: Two notches on the same lower edge

questions.correctAnswer: Two notches on adjacent outer edges, mirrored across the diagonal
questions.explanation: Reflecting the outer-edge notch across the diagonal places its mate on the adjacent outer edge.

questions.prompt:
The following figures share one rule:
1. Outer ○; inner □; + below
2. Outer △; inner ◇; + below
3. Outer ☆; inner ○; + below
Which choice follows the same rule?
questions.correctAnswer: Outer □; inner △; + below
questions.explanation: One open shape contains a different open shape, with a plus sign below.

questions.prompt:
The following groups share one rule:
1. ● ○ ○
2. ■ □ □
3. ▲ △ △
Which choice follows the same rule?
questions.explanation: Each group begins with one filled shape followed by two matching open versions.

questions.prompt:
The following arrangements share one rule:
1. Left ↑; center ○; right ↓
2. Left ←; center □; right →
3. Left ↓; center △; right ↑
Which choice follows the same rule?
questions.correctAnswer: Left →; center ◇; right ←
questions.explanation: Opposite arrows surround one open shape; → and ← are opposite around open ◇.

questions.prompt:
The following sequences share one rule:
1. ○ + □ ×
2. △ + ◇ ×
3. ☆ + ○ ×
Which choice follows the same rule?
questions.explanation: Two different open shapes occupy positions 1 and 3, with + second and × fourth.

questions.prompt:
Complete the matrix. Across each row, the first and third symbols exchange positions while the middle stays fixed.
Row 1: ○ + □ | □ + ○
Row 2: △ × ◇ | ?
questions.explanation: Swapping the first and third symbols gives ◇ × △.

questions.prompt:
Complete the matrix. Down each column, the number of symbols doubles.
Top-left: ○
Bottom-left: ○ ○
Top-right: □ □
Bottom-right: ?
questions.explanation: Doubling two open squares produces four open squares.

questions.prompt:
Complete the matrix. In each row, the right cell changes every filled shape to open and leaves positions unchanged.
Row 1: Top ●; bottom ■ | Top ○; bottom □
Row 2: Left ▲; right ◆ | ?
questions.correctAnswer: Left △; right ◇
questions.explanation: Both filled shapes change to their open forms without changing left-right positions.

questions.prompt:
Complete the matrix. Across each row, the line rotates 90° clockwise and moves from left of the shape to right of it.
Row 1: | ○ | ○ -
Row 2: / □ | ?
questions.explanation: Rotating / clockwise gives \, and the line moves to the right of □.
Removing the shared × leaves + and ★.

questions.prompt: A square is folded from bottom to top. A hole is punched near the folded paper’s left outer edge, away from corners. What appears after unfolding?

choices.B: Two holes on the left side, mirrored across the horizontal centerline
choices.C: Two holes on opposite side edges

questions.correctAnswer: Two holes on the left side, mirrored across the horizontal centerline
questions.explanation: The horizontal unfold creates a matching hole on the same left side at the reflected height.

questions.prompt: A rectangle is folded right to left and then bottom to top. A hole is punched near the folded paper’s upper-left area, away from all edges. What appears after unfolding?

choices.A: Two holes in the upper half
choices.C: Four holes in corresponding positions across both centerlines

questions.correctAnswer: Four holes in corresponding positions across both centerlines
questions.explanation: Two perpendicular folds reflect the punch into four corresponding locations.

questions.prompt: A square is folded along the diagonal from upper-left to lower-right. A semicircular cut is made on the diagonal folded edge, away from corners. What appears after unfolding?

choices.C: One complete circular opening centered on the diagonal
choices.D: One semicircle on an outer edge

questions.correctAnswer: One complete circular opening centered on the diagonal
questions.explanation: The semicircular cut on the fold reflects to form one complete circle centered on that diagonal.

questions.prompt: A square is folded from left to right. Two holes are punched on the vertical centerline of the folded rectangle at different heights, away from all edges. What appears after unfolding?

choices.A: Four holes forming two horizontal pairs
choices.B: Two holes remaining on one line
choices.C: Four holes forming two vertical pairs

questions.correctAnswer: Four holes forming two horizontal pairs
questions.explanation: Each off-fold punch reflects horizontally, creating two horizontal pairs and four holes.

questions.prompt:
The following arrangements share one rule:
1. ○ inside □; × outside
2. △ inside ◇; × outside
3. ☆ inside ○; × outside
Which choice follows the same rule?
questions.correctAnswer: □ inside △; × outside
questions.explanation: One open shape is inside a different open shape, with × outside.

questions.prompt:
The following sequences share one rule:
1. ● ○ ■ □
2. ▲ △ ◆ ◇
3. ★ ☆ ● ○
Which choice follows the same rule?
questions.explanation: Each sequence contains filled-open pairs of two different shapes.

questions.prompt:
The following arrangements share one rule:
1. Top +; left ○; right □
2. Top +; left △; right ◇
3. Top +; left ☆; right ○
Which choice follows the same rule?
questions.correctAnswer: Top +; left □; right △
questions.explanation: A plus is above two different open shapes.

questions.prompt:
The following pairs share one rule:
1. ○ becomes ○ ○ ○
2. □ becomes □ □ □
3. △ becomes △ △ △
Which choice follows the same rule?
questions.correctAnswer: ◇ becomes ◇ ◇ ◇
questions.explanation: One open symbol becomes three identical copies of itself.

questions.prompt:
Complete the matrix. In each row, the right cell moves the center symbol to both ends.
Row 1: ○ + □ | + ○ □ +
Row 2: △ × ◇ | ?
questions.explanation: The center × is copied to both ends of the unchanged △ ◇ pair.

questions.prompt:
Complete the matrix. Down each column, a filled shape becomes open and moves from top to bottom.
Top-left: Top ●
Bottom-left: Bottom ○
Top-right: Top ■
Bottom-right: ?
questions.correctAnswer: Bottom □
questions.explanation: The filled square becomes open and moves from top to bottom.

questions.prompt:
Complete the matrix. Across each row, the second cell contains one fewer symbol and changes open to filled.
Row 1: ○ ○ ○ | ● ●
Row 2: □ □ □ □ | ?
questions.explanation: Four open squares become three filled squares.

questions.prompt:
Complete the matrix. Across each row, the arrow turns 45° counterclockwise and the shape changes from filled to open.
Row 1: → ● | / ○
Row 2: ↓ ■ | ?
questions.explanation: Turning ↓ 45° counterclockwise gives \, and ■ becomes open □.

questions.prompt: A square is folded from right to left. Three holes are punched in a vertical column on the folded paper, away from all edges. What appears after unfolding?

choices.A: Three holes on the vertical fold
choices.B: Six holes forming three horizontal mirrored pairs
choices.C: Six holes in one vertical line

questions.correctAnswer: Six holes forming three horizontal mirrored pairs
questions.explanation: Each of the three punches reflects horizontally, producing three mirrored pairs and six holes.

questions.prompt: A rectangle is folded from top to bottom. A notch is cut from the folded paper’s right outer edge, away from corners. What appears after unfolding?

choices.B: Two notches on opposite side edges
choices.C: Two matching notches on the right edge, mirrored vertically

questions.correctAnswer: Two matching notches on the right edge, mirrored vertically
questions.explanation: The horizontal unfold reflects the notch to another position on the same right edge.

questions.prompt: A square is folded left to right and then top to bottom. A triangular cut is made on the folded paper’s vertical outer edge, away from corners. What appears after unfolding?

choices.A: Four cuts, two on each opposite vertical edge
choices.C: Two cuts on the vertical centerline
choices.D: Eight cuts on all four edges

questions.correctAnswer: Four cuts, two on each opposite vertical edge
questions.explanation: One unfold doubles the cut vertically and the other mirrors both to the opposite vertical edge.

questions.prompt: A square is folded along the diagonal from upper-left to lower-right. One hole is punched near each of two different outer edges of the folded triangle, away from corners. What appears after unfolding?

choices.C: Four holes forming two pairs mirrored across the diagonal

questions.correctAnswer: Four holes forming two pairs mirrored across the diagonal
questions.explanation: Each of the two off-fold punches reflects once, producing two mirrored pairs.

questions.prompt:
The following arrangements share one rule:
1. ○ above ●
2. □ above ■
3. △ above ▲
Which choice follows the same rule?
questions.correctAnswer: ◇ above ◆
questions.explanation: An open shape appears above its matching filled form.

questions.prompt:
The following groups share one rule:
1. + + ○ ×
2. + + □ ×
3. + + △ ×
Which choice follows the same rule?
questions.explanation: Two plus signs are followed by one open shape and then ×.

questions.prompt:
The following figures share one rule:
1. Outer □; ○ at bottom-right inside
2. Outer ◇; △ at bottom-right inside
3. Outer ○; ☆ at bottom-right inside
Which choice follows the same rule?
questions.correctAnswer: Outer △; □ at bottom-right
questions.explanation: An open outer shape contains a different open shape at the bottom-right.

questions.prompt:
The following sequences share one rule:
1. ↑ → ↓ ←
2. → ↓ ← ↑
3. ↓ ← ↑ →
Which choice follows the same rule?
questions.explanation: Each sequence turns 90° clockwise at every step; ←, ↑, →, ↓ follows that rule.

questions.prompt:
The following groups share one rule:
1. ○ □ ○ □ ○
2. △ ◇ △ ◇ △
3. ☆ ○ ☆ ○ ☆
Which choice follows the same rule?
questions.explanation: Each group alternates two open shapes and begins and ends with the first shape.
